tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search profiled products by keywords and filters. Ranking: keyword match (name, then capability/integration tags, then description), ties broken by GitHub stars of the product's own repository. Returns up to `limit` results with URL, type, publisher, licence, tags and vendor-claimed platforms.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Full record for one product: description, licence, hosting, install packages and endpoints, capabilities, integrations, per-platform compatibility status with the reason, permission signals, known advisories, evaluation dimensions, closest alternatives, and the provenance of each field.

tools.name: compare_products
tools.description: Side-by-side facts for 2 to 4 products: type, licence, hosting, stars, last push, capabilities and integrations shared by all versus unique to each, and compatibility statuses. Unknown values are returned as null, never assumed.

tools.name: list_platforms
tools.description: Agent platforms (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, ChatGPT, Gemini CLI…) with vendor, kind, whether each documents MCP and Agent Skills support, extension mechanisms and lifecycle. Researched records with sources and a check date.

tools.name: market_segments
tools.description: Categories, capabilities and integrations with the number of indexed products and a momentum label. Use it to find slugs for search_products filters and to see which areas are crowded or thin. Counts cover the whole catalogue.

tools.name: list_opportunities
tools.description: Gaps in the ecosystem scored on six weighted components (demand, competition gap, monetization, growth, feasibility, distribution), each with evidence for and against marked measured or heuristic. "integration-gap" has measured demand; "underserved-capability" is a hypothesis.

tools.name: recent_changes
tools.description: Most recent releases, field changes and removals recorded for profiled products.
